quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon collaborates with NVIDIA on gallium nitride-based (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon (release): Infineon is advancing its collaboration with NVIDIA on 800 VDC power architectures for AI data centers, centered on GaN-based high-voltage intermediate bus converters (IBC), building on joint work first announced in May 2025 and the power path protection (hot-swap) work announced in October 2025. Its GaN portfolio supports 800 V to 50 V, 800 V to 12 V and 800 V to 6 V conversion at switching frequencies of up to 1 MHz, with PSoC control C3 and EiceDRIVER products completing full IBC system solutions; Infineon offers IBC solutions across silicon, GaN and SiC.
quarterly_data.figure: GaN IBC 800 V to 50 V / 12 V / 6 V, up to 1 MHz
